bio: A restaurant with a relaxed, informal feel which sees itself as a clone of the original Llama Inn in Brooklyn (New York), the name of which pays homage to this typical Andean animal and to this traditional type of hostelry that always extends a warm welcome to guests. The aim of the cuisine here is to bring Peruvian flavours to the Spanish capital in dishes that are mainly designed for sharing (scallop ceviche, grouper tiradito, yakimeshi of king prawns etc), alongside others they describe as the “fiesta final” (sautéed beef and duck jerky with rice). A tasting menu, entitled “Trust The Chef” and served to the whole table, is also available....
